notes: Decent start (Yagi-Uda steal T1, Hybrid Release T11, Archives steal of Longevity Serum T18), but from T12 to T23 it clicked for credits every turn, going from 21 to 64 credits on a 5-card grip. It never drew for a fracter to beat Tatu-Bola and never contested Server 4, where the Corp advanced and scored Fujii Asset Retrieval (T14-15) and the winning Project Yagi-Uda (T22-24).

Log is cut off at T5 with no winner; Hedge Fund economy and fast scores of Architect Deployment Test (T3) and Superconducting Hub (T5) were good. R&D was left unprotected T1-T4 (nine Runner accesses), and on T5 Ansel 1.0's install subroutine was used to put ice over the rezzed 6-credit Ansel on Server 2, trashing its own best ice.

Ran a 3-4 card HQ 13 times in T1-T4, seeing the same Retribution, Hammer and Wall to Wall again and again, and left Server 1 alone on T1 while Above the Law sat in it, so the Corp scored it T2. It never drew or built economy, sitting at 5 credits and 3 cards against Weyland, and was flatlined by Measured Response on T5.

Sensible scoring remote (Project Ingatan T3 and T8, Megaprix and Superconducting Hub with Wage Workers clicks), and Bloop on T6 crippled the Runner's rig. Small inefficiencies: it clicked for credits at 15 credits on T5 and sat on 22-23 credits on T6 without advancing its board, while one Wave on R&D gave up a Megaprix steal on T1.

The HQ steal of Longevity Serum on T2 was good, but it then facechecked R&D into Vampyronassa with 3 credits and 2 cards, and ran into the same rezzed, unbreakable Vampyronassa again on T4 and T7, losing credits and 6 cards to net damage. Its economy stayed at 0-4 credits most of the game, so it could not contest Server 1 while Jinteki scored Fujii, Hybrid Release, Longevity Serum and Hybrid Release.

It reached 5 points by T12, then from T13 to T19 clicked for credits with a full hand every turn (13 to 28 credits), discarding each turn and installing nothing. The R&D ice was never rezzed all game, which gave up Architect Deployment Test (T11) and Project Ingatan (T20); Superconducting Hub was also installed T7 behind ice it could not afford to rez (3 credits) and was stolen.

Ran R&D into Hammer with no breaker on T2, T3, T4 and T5, taking a tag each time against Weyland and spending clicks and credits to clear them. It reached 6 points by T10 with steals of SDS, Divested Trust and Above the Law, then spent T11-T18 at 0-2 credits running HQ through Afshar for the same Government Subsidy and Luana Campos, never building the economy or a fracter to contest Server 3, where Above the Law, Transport Monopoly and SDS were scored.

After T3 it never ran or installed again: from T4 to T15 every click went to gaining 1 credit, reaching 55 credits on a 5-card grip. Meanwhile Weyland scored Divested Trust (T7), Above the Law (T11), Divested Trust (T14) and Transport Monopoly (T16) from one remote, uncontested.

R&D had only Ping all game (the Runner ran it about 14 times, stealing Embedded Reporting and Tomorrow's Headline), and Post-Truth Dividend sat unadvanced on T5 and was stolen via Spree. From T14 to T18 it spent 9 clicks and about 18 credits trashing Daily Casts again and again, dropping to 2 credits, then installed and double-advanced Next Big Thing on T17 behind Grubber/VSA, where it was stolen for the loss; it also clicked for credits with a full hand on T9-T10.

Efficient NBN rush from a Ping-protected remote, scoring Embedded Reporting T3, Next Big Thing T6 and Tomorrow's Headline T8 to win. R&D was left open T1-T2 and the remote stayed thin, which worked only because the Runner was passive.

Put two ice on HQ on T1 and left R&D unprotected until T4, giving up 12 free R&D accesses (it got lucky). Scoring through Server 2 (Next Big Thing T6, Tomorrow's Headline T8) was fine, but the middle game drifted: it advanced ice on HQ T12, used Next Big Thing to shuffle 10 cards back on T15, and idled several turns before winning T18.

Solid: Buzzsaw on Afshar for cheap R&D pressure (Transport Monopoly and Divested Trust on T3, Above the Law T9), and it used Banner on Akhet to steal SDS from HQ on T5, trashing Buzzsaw and reinstalling it T8. The only small blemish was low-value HQ runs at 1-2 credits on T6.

Won T11 with a steady remote (Embedded Reporting T6, Next Big Thing T8 and T11). It kept Tomorrow's Headline in HQ behind one VSA while holding 13 credits, and it was stolen T3; it also drew into end-of-turn discards on T2 and T4 and left R&D unprotected T1-T2.

Ran HQ four times on T1 instead of hitting the Server 1 agenda (Longevity Serum, scored T2), and re-ran into known Hafrún on R&D on T5. A strong T9 (Longevity Serum and Fujii steals, reaching 6 points) ended with Transfer of Wealth emptying the grip to 0 cards against Jinteki, and Mindscaping's 1 net damage flatlined it on T10.

Aggressive and effective: Longevity Serum from R&D T2, Hybrid Release through Karunā T4, and Fujii plus Hybrid Release from HQ to win T6. Minor errors were running into known Tatu-Bola with 0 credits on T2 and running the naked Server 3 (Urtica Cipher) on T5, which cut the grip to 1 card against Jinteki.

Built a 4-ice Server 1 and never installed an agenda in it; from T7 to T10 it clicked for credits and drew with a 6-card hand (reaching 27 credits), discarding each turn while holding Méliès City Luxury Line and Superconducting Hub. The R&D ice was never rezzed, so Ingatan and Architect Deployment Test were stolen T5, and Méliès was stolen from HQ behind a single Hagen on T10.

Paid 2 credits each time to Banner through Akhet on HQ about 13 times (T4-T15), mostly seeing Government Subsidy again, and spent T5-T10 at 0-4 credits. It never ran Server 1 while Weyland scored Transport Monopoly (T12), Above the Law (T14), Divested Trust (T15) and SDS Drone Deployment (T17); it also facechecked Hammer on R&D on T10 and clicked for credits on T16 instead of contesting the advanced SDS.

Played Hedge Fund and Sprint on T1 with R&D unprotected, and Méliès was stolen at once; Superconducting Hub was later stolen from HQ behind a lone Vertigo on T5. Three Nico Campaigns were installed naked (T3, T4, T6) and trashed, and it clicked for credits at 15-25 credits on T12-T13, but the 4-ice Server 3 scored enough for the win on T16.

R&D had only Vertigo until T9 and gave up Architect Deployment Test and Ingatan, and on T5 Ingatan in Server 1 was stolen because the Corp did not rez the ice despite 16 credits. With the Runner at 6 points, on T14 it installed Megaprix Qualifier behind Drafter/Bloop, which have no end-the-run subroutines, and the Runner walked in for the win.

A good T1 (Above the Law and Divested Trust from open R&D) was followed by 8 HQ runs on T2-T3 that saw the same Afshar, Descent and Hammer. From T5 to T19 it clicked for credits every single turn, reaching 71 credits on a 5-card grip with no runs, while Weyland scored Transport Monopoly (T8), Above the Law (T12) and Divested Trust (T20) from Server 1.
